meta.project: ORI — Asistente IA para Integro Suite

product_overview: Admin panel and embeddable chat widget to configure, monitor and operate 'Ori' — an AI assistant for Integro Suite. Provides login-protected management of AI model settings, bot identity, knowledge base crawling/indexing, widget customization, conversations/leads, and integrations with webhook/email.
core_goals: Enable non-developers to configure and deploy an embeddable AI chat widget (Ori) via an admin UI.
Provide RAG-enabled knowledge management: crawl websites, upload documents, chunk and index content with vector search.
Allow secure management of OpenAI API configuration and model parameters with encrypted storage.
Capture conversation analytics, leads, and provide export/integration mechanisms (webhooks, email).
Offer live preview and embed code for a domain-whitelisted, Shadow-DOM chat widget.
